messages:
lucy: Heads up — noticed the Runtime Guide TOC lost an entry after the recent header tidy. The sidebar no longer links to the KV cache tuning section, it just jumps to Top.
omar: ah ok. could be an anchor rename from a dash or colon change. do you have the page link?
lucy: https://internal.docs.redwood/runtime/guide.md — in staging the anchor used by the runbook is 404.
lucy: snippet from the file:
```
- title: KV cache tuning
  id: kv-cache-tuning
```
but I think the rendered heading is now `## KV-cache tuning` so anchor changed to `kv-cache-tuning-1` or something.
sudha: I own runtime-guide, will take a look. if it's a frontmatter/id mismatch I'll restore the canonical id and add a redirect. can someone paste the failing runbook link?
lucy: runbook link -> /runbooks/kv-cache#kv-cache-tuning (this is the one 404ing in staging)
morgan: I can review a tiny PR. also +1 to adding a docs smoke test for anchors so this doesn't slip. @ci-bot could we run the link-checker on staging after the fix?
ci-bot: link-check triggered for staging branch (job: docs-linkcheck). I'll post results here when done.
sudha: creating PR now — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1427 — fixes frontmatter id and adds a short redirect in runtime/README.md
omar: nice. quick question — do we prefer canonical ids with no punctuation? should we standardize a rule in the style guide (e.g. lower-hyphen only)?
sudha: yes, let's standardize to lowercase-hyphen and no punctuation. I'll add a one-line note in the docs contributing guide in the PR.
morgan: looked at PR, tiny nit: remove the trailing space in the frontmatter example. otherwise LGTM :+1:
lucy: thanks everyone — that should unblock the runbook smoke tests. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: link-check completed: 1 broken -> 0 broken after merge to staging (validated links: /runbooks/kv-cache#kv-cache-tuning)
morgan: I'll merge after CI green. thanks sudha for the quick fix.
sudha: merged and backfilled the contributing note. follow-up task: add an automated anchor-check step to the docs CI (file issue later).
thread_summary: Quick coordination about a missing TOC entry/anchor in the Runtime Guide; owner fixes frontmatter id, CI link-check verifies, PR reviewed and merged, standardization note added.
